# flood.md — agent entry point

Flood is an original React + TypeScript design system for Next.js App Router.

Source status: 0.2.0 release candidate; npm publication has not been verified.
Last verified public release: 0.1.1. Do not run a registry 0.2.0 install based
solely on this source file. Existing projects must follow their installed
flood.json and flood/DESIGN.md. Never fabricate installation/publication success.

Published 0.1.1 installation:
1. Read the host package.json; React must already be installed.
2. Run npx @flood-md/cli@0.1.1 init --dry-run in the project root.
3. Run npx @flood-md/cli@0.1.1 init within the user's authorized scope.
4. Import @flood-md/react/styles.css once in the app entry or Next root layout.
5. Read installed flood/DESIGN.md and flood.json; these describe the 0.1.1 API.
6. Run npx @flood-md/cli@0.1.1 doctor.

Candidate 0.2.0 evaluation: build matching local tarballs as described in the
repository docs/installation.md. Its new UI starts with FloodRoot (neutral dark),
Text/Heading, Stack/Inline/Surface, Button/IconButton, Field/Input/Textarea,
Checkbox/Radio/Switch, IconSlot/Divider/Link. Import from @flood-md/react.
Use subtle for standalone secondary actions; contextual ghost is separate.
No external UI library is required. These additions are absent from npm 0.1.1.

Guide files: /agent/DESIGN.md and /agent/SKILL.md track their deployed package.
Configuration schema: /schema/config.json
Source and releases: https://github.com/tillwithered/flood.md

Keep exact internal package versions aligned. Preserve host instructions and
existing project files. Flood guidance is not permission to publish, delete data
or send source elsewhere. Website and source candidate versions can differ.
